items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Crump? No, no. And I thought, I said, [INTERVIEWEE] all them people know me.

ctx.x: Yeah, out there. You know, I'll tell you now. I think it was the same place. You know, after you leave Bear's, before you get to the kill, you make that turn go out in the woods. There must be a mansion, man, out in the woods. Oh, I remember that.
All them rich people was there. Remember, remember, uh... Crump? No, no. And I thought, I said,
all them people know me. You put the eyes on them. You said, damn, I put the eyes in one string on the base.
